0.original: Eilis requires you to supply the lines of Tidegate.

1.original: Eilis has asked you to deliver rations to the two tidegates. See one serving to the hands of Nortmoen in the north, and Sthalrhet to the south.

2.original: You have delivered both servings of rations and borne witness to the sibling rivalry forewarned. Notify Eilis that the provisions have reached their destinations.

3.original: While Eilis bemoans the brothers' bickering, she trusts the pair will work in lockstep when war comes to the wall.

48.original: Guarding a wall so vast as Tidegate requires the manpower of two brigades, and maintaining a unified defense requires they act in tandem.

49.original: This task has been entrusted to the brigades of the brothers Nortmoen and Sthalrhet, yet I fear they hold each other in esteem far from fraternal, bickering over the slightest of unintended slights.

50.original: And so I need ask an outsider, namely you, to bring provisions to Nortmoen of the north side and Sthalrhet of the south side, to allay any appearance of impropriety.

51.original: We've set aside two perfectly equal sets of rations for them, though you'll likely have your hands full convincing them of that.

52.original: Aye, I am Nortmoen, adventurer. What business have you here?

53.original: Ah, rations? An adventurer bearing rations is always welcome...but I cannot help but think you bear even more rations for my brother's men.

54.original: If you have come looking for Sthalrhet, you've found him. Now, what of it?

55.original: Ah, but what is this you have brought us? Salted fish? You insult my men with brine-soaked brill while my brother dines on the fresh fruits of the sea?

56.original: I take it you witnessed their silly sibling rivalry firsthand, and now understand why some wonder whether the two can cooperate long enough to hold the wall.

57.original: But nothing unites like a common enemy, and I have no doubt the brothers will set aside their petty differences when faced with the greater danger.
